**Triage: first-touch grading** — `pm:queue` · `domain:cli` · `priority:p2` · `bug`. Reading taken in THIS act, 2026-09-20T08:51Z. <sub>本评论来自分诊座位</sub>

**Lands in the two pending changesets** (and the CLI source they contradict) ⇒ `domain:cli`. **Class (b)**: both still assert, as a claim, a per-package dedup sentence the CLI source **forbids**.

**⚠️ `p2` and it carries a hard window, which is the part that decides it.** The changesets are **pending and unreleased**, so today the fix is editing two files. **The moment they release, the false claim is frozen into the CHANGELOG** — a published artefact that cannot be edited retroactively without a correction entry. ⇒ the cost of this card is a step function, not a slope, and it is cheap **only** before the next release.

⇒ ⭐ **This should be taken before the next version release, ⛔ not merely 「when p2 comes up」.** ⛔ This seat is not escalating it to p1 — nothing is broken and no user is affected — but a grade alone does not communicate a deadline, so it is stated here: **the release is the deadline**, and if a Version Packages PR opens with these changesets still in it, that is the last cheap moment.

## `pm:blocked` — `Blocked-by: #18823`. Measured, not assumed.

This card cannot be dispatched while PR #18867 is open, and the reason is a **hard file serial**, not a judgement call:

| | |
|---|---|
| PR #18867's complete file list | **`.changeset/18677-validate-per-package-authoring-pass.md`** — one file, nothing else |
| this card's named files | `.changeset/18677-validate-per-package-authoring-pass.md`, `.changeset/18778-lint-per-package-authoring-pass.md`, `.changeset/18779-per-package-dedup-positional-key.md` |

⇒ the overlap is exact on `18677-…`. Same **file** is a hard serial in this lane (same *package* is exempt). ⛔ Dispatching this card now would put two branches on one changeset file, and the loser silently drops the other's correction.

### ⚠️ The coupling is not just mechanical — it is the same file's same defect class

PR #18867 is parked on a `Maintainer-action:` (`5724913518`), and its content must be **re-derived** before it can land: #18878 falsified its `After: both report 4`. This card then records a **second** defect in that same changeset — a sentence the CLI source now explicitly forbids restating, attributed to `compile.ts`, which no longer says it.

⭐ ⇒ they are one piece of work on one file, and fixing either alone leaves the file wrong. Whoever unparks #18823 should take both together.

### ⏳ What this park now costs, recorded once and ⛔ not re-asked

This card carries a **hard deadline of its own**: 「下次发版即固化」 — the two changesets are **pending and unreleased**, so the next release writes the retired sentence into the CHANGELOG permanently, where it stops being a pending correction and becomes published history.

⛔ That is **not** an argument for dispatching around the park, and ⛔ not a reason to re-ask the maintainer. It is recorded so the cost of the park is visible when it is next looked at, rather than discovered after a release.

### ⛔ Why this was not split to dispatch the other two files

Two of the three files (`18778-…`, `18779-…`) are free, so a fenced dispatch was possible. It was declined: the three assertions are **one claim in three places**, and landing two of them leaves the card open, the file set half-corrected, and a future reader unable to tell which of the three was deliberate. ⇒ a half-corrected claim is worse than an uncorrected one, because it looks settled.
